item.tib: kun skyobs byams ma sngags bstod kyi tshig don mdo tsam bstan pa'i sdud 'grel thar lam them skas
item.coloph: zhes byams ma'i bstod 'brel 'di yang zhib rgyas su bstan pa nus na/ lha yi mtshan dang tshig lung rig pa dang sbyar nas/ le'u tshan chen po nyer gcig phyes nas po ti du mar long pa 'dug kyang / phran rang nas tshod dpag gi lung las/ tshe zad pa bsring bar nus kyang las rnam par smin pa ni gang la yang ma gtogs so/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ las rkyen zung 'brel gzugs gzhi shin tu mi bde ba'i gces pas tshe 'di'i skabs thog tho long tsam du/ sgo btsun nyi ming pas/ bris pa la/ nyes 'gal song na mkha' 'gro gnyan la mthol bshags phul nas/ smras pa/ bdag kyang 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ bdag lta 'khor ba'i sa bon gtan spangs nas/ bdag med don rtogs stong nyid mngon gyur te/ bdag gzhan don rnams lhun grub mthar phyin shog/
